common_issues: Wrong Orb Vallis cycle split: prose said '~13 min warm / ~13 min cold' (equal split); corrected to ~16:40 warm / ~6:40 cold, total 26min20s
Wrong Cambion Drift cycle: frontmatter and prose both said '~6min30s per phase' (13 min total); corrected to 100 min total (same as Plains)
Invalid quest slugs: 'warframe-1999' does not exist in quests/ (Hollvania); 'profit-taker' and 'exploiter-orb' are not quest slugs (Orb Vallis)
Ropalolyst incorrectly listed as an Orb Vallis boss -- Ropalolyst is on Jupiter, not Venus
Tusk Thumper variants incorrectly included 'Bolkor-class' -- Bolkors are aerial gunships, not Thumper variants; correct variants are Tusk Thumper / Tusk Thumper Doma / Tusk Thumper Bull
Zariman 'circuit-override' listed as a feature and 'Circuit Override' described as a mission type -- not a canonical Zariman mission (The Circuit is Duviri content)
Zariman faction_primary 'Grineer (Angel-touched)' was misleadingly narrow -- both Void-corrupted Grineer and Corpus populate the ship
Zariman Angels named 'Angel of Ambulas / Justice / Wrath' -- patrol Angels have no canonical individual names; only quest Angel (Kira) is named
Laetum incorrectly attributed to 'Entrati Labs bounty line' in Zariman -- both Laetum and Phenmor come from Holdfasts syndicate on the Zariman
the-deadlock-protocol incorrectly listed as Cambion Drift access quest -- it gates Protea, not Cambion Drift
